title: Bob Baker MITRE paper on Ning Li's AC/DC gravity

tellings.quote: aspect. However, there is a paper that was released by Bob Baker under the MITRE Corporation for one of the high-frequency gravitational wave conferences where

plain: A man named Bob Baker is said to have written a paper on the physicist Ning Li's idea known as AC/DC gravity, a proposed way of making gravity-like forces with electrical currents. He wrote it under the MITRE Corporation, a US research contractor, for one of the conferences on high-frequency gravitational waves, ripples in space and time far faster than the ones astronomers usually study. Dave Rossi, a guest who talks about advanced physics, brings it up as a paper he has read and gives no further source. The story places it in the 2000s. Rossi offers it as a sign that serious researchers took Li's work seriously.
